Hi Product Hunt, I'm Steven Hacker (yes, that's my real name), founder of MePersona.

I spent 25 years making film and TV with some of the biggest names in Hollywood. The artists I know all hit the same wall: burnout. They go silent, or hand replies to a social media manager who doesn't sound like them. True fans can tell.

MePersona learns how you talk from your posts, replies and a voice recording, then drafts answers to every fan comment and DM across nine platforms in one inbox. You approve, and it gets sharper with every reply.

Product Hunt exclusive: one month of Premium free, no card.

Two questions:

1. Would you let an AI reply as you? What would it have to prove first? [...] >
> Surge mode. When a post goes viral, MePersona now handles it on its own. Once a post gets 30 comments in an hour or less, it waits a few minutes, ranks the whole wave, and drafts replies for the comments worth answering: questions, people asking for the price or the link, returning fans. Spam, trolls and three-word praise are skipped, and every skipped comment is marked with the reason so the creator can answer anything. Most important, a comment surge can never use up all the messages/tokens a creator has, and it protects their accounts from being flagged for spam.

# MePersona — The AI Unified Inbox for Content Creators

MePersona is an AI-powered unified inbox for content creators. It brings fan messages from across your platforms into one dashboard and drafts replies in your own voice, so you can keep up genuine fan engagement at scale — without hiring a team or losing what makes you sound like you.

## What is MePersona?

MePersona consolidates fan messages from major creator platforms — including X, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Telegram, Discord, Bluesky, LinkedIn, and Facebook — into a single inbox. You train your persona once, and MePersona drafts voice-matched replies to your fans. Every reply waits for your approval before it's sent. MePersona is fully bilingual, working in both English and Spanish.

## How MePersona is different [...] ## Frequently asked questions

### What is MePersona?

MePersona is an AI-powered unified inbox for content creators. It brings fan messages from across your platforms into one dashboard and drafts replies in your own voice, so you can keep up genuine fan engagement at scale.

### Which platforms does MePersona connect to?

MePersona consolidates fan messages from major creator platforms including X, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Telegram, Discord, Bluesky, LinkedIn, and Facebook, with more being added.

### How is this different from a DM automation tool?

DM automation tools send templated blasts and comment-to-DM funnels. MePersona drafts genuine, voice-matched replies to real fan messages — and nothing sends without your approval.

### Does MePersona reply in my own voice? [...] ## How MePersona is different

Unlike DM automation tools that send templated blasts and comment-to-DM funnels, MePersona drafts genuine, personalized replies to real fan messages in your own voice. It is a relationship inbox, not a marketing autoresponder — and nothing sends without your review.

## Key features

## Who MePersona is for

MePersona is built for content creators, influencers, and digital entrepreneurs who manage fan messages across multiple platforms and want to reply personally at scale — including English- and Spanish-speaking creators.

## Pricing

MePersona offers a free plan to get started, and every paid plan begins with a 7-day free trial. Paid tiers: Premium ($29/mo), Pro ($99/mo), and Pro Elite ($149/mo).
